content:
# Equinox

⚠️ **WARNING: Images contain all tasks and Rewards!**⚠️ 

**Equinox Info**
It contains many new unlocks, some are very beneficial and I would highly recommend unlocking it and checking out the Tasks, some require some time to prepare for.

**Getting to Equinox**
Equinox is located in World 3, behind Bloodbones. Kill them until they drop a mirror and use it.

**Upgrading Equinox**
Once you complete some of the tasks, you will unlock Buffs that you can upgrade. To upgrade these buffs you must wait until your bar fills up, once it's full (max) you can upgrade any of your unlocked buffs. The more Cloud Tasks you complete, the faster it fills up. Another huge increase is the first new vial, unlocked through the 2nd bubble.

**Skilling in Equinox**
You can only do 2 minute afk claims inside Equinox.

**How to get Lucky Lad on Beginner Class**
Do Mining Dreadlo with 100%+ Efficiency. Cap your mining speed (61/min) with buff food, increase it with better tools, gold food boost from statue (onyx) and upgrade cards to reach it (easily done with festive food, only need 1 festive food per game session, no matter the offline length, you must disable auto arm food refiller if you do this).
Then use Afk Gain Cards and DR. Remember Chips etc. (anything you use for sampling, but don't need the extra effy) then candy the dreadlo.


**Vial Unlocks**
Vial 1 = Marble Ore = Faster Equinox Bar fill rate (+237% at level 13)
Vial 2 = Willow Log = Faster Sigil rate
Vial 3 = Equinox Fish = Build Rate but is infact Build Speed! It affects Con XP and Flag rate too!
Vial 4 = Dream Particulate = Faster Shrine Rate

**Killroy extra Unlocks**
1 = Faster Respawn of mobs in Killroy (stick with time if you need the 2k+ dream, this is underwhelming)
2 = Dungeon Rates (think currency, still a bit confused?)
3 = Pearl Drop
